### Flight Cancellation Policy
- **Free cancellation window:** Full refund within 24 hours (domestic) or 48 hours (international) of booking
- **Basic Economy:** Not cancellable after the free window (unless insured)
- **Economy Domestic:** Cancellation fee = max($50, 15% of ticket price)
- **Economy International:** Cancellation fee = max($75, 20% of ticket price)
- **Business Domestic:** 5% of ticket price
- **Business International:** 8% of ticket price
- **First Class:** Free cancellation
- **Travel Insurance:** Covers cancellation regardless of cabin class

### Hotel Cancellation Policy
- **48+ hours before check-in:** Free cancellation
- **24–48 hours before check-in:** 50% of first night charge
- **Under 24 hours before check-in:** Full first night charge
- **Suites:** Non-refundable (full charge regardless of timing)

### Car Rental Cancellation Policy
- **24+ hours before pickup:** Free cancellation
- **Under 24 hours before pickup:** One day charge
- **Luxury/SUV rentals:** Additional $50 cancellation surcharge at all times
